Peskov claims Europeans will have to be part of the talks at some stage, since discussing mutual security for Russia and Ukraine means discussing the future of Europe's security system.

He says special envoy Kirill Dmitriev hasn't returned from the US yet and hasn't reported to

NATO chief Rutte says Europe is no saint either, since it bought far more Russian LNG this year than the US diesel deal amounts to. Rutte says the war will likely end in a compromise and Ukraine is unlikely to regain all its territories. https://t.co/YfPQcGI2BS
